scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Rachel,

We spoke in March about consumer coverage, and I'd like to send a short update since then.

I spent the summer as an intern at Pinecrest Wealth Partners in Atlanta, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks that was used in client portfolio reviews. I'm also a consumer sector analyst in Duke Investment Club.

I saw on LinkedIn that you were promoted to Director. Congratulations!

If you have 10 minutes to catch up this fall, I'd love to hear how the new role is going, and there's no pressure at all if things are busy. Thank you again for the time you gave me in March.

Best,

If you have 10 minutes to catch up this fall, I'd love to hear how the new role is going, though I understand if the promotion has kept you busy. Thank you again for the time you gave me in March.
